items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know he didn't work with Punch... Did Punch have his own band in those days? Well, I don't think he was in the regular line up.

ctx.x: But I think Billy, I think Billy and Mary McMulls was both in Mobile, if I ain't mistaken. I believe he is, from Mobile, I believe.
Well, I'll ask Punch. He worked with them for a long time.
Yeah, I worked with them. I worked with them at the Belmont Theater in Pensacola Florida.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Did you ever talk to Billy and Didi

ctx.x: He told the mule to open his mouth. He would stand up there with his lip hanging on and say, Why don't you open your mouth and quit licking at me?
Did you ever talk to the Preserv... Huh? Did you ever talk to Billy and Didi or any of the musicians who played at the Fillmore or any of those? What Billy?
The musicians, you ever talk to the guys at Preservation Hall, all the musicians, about all their travels when they go up to New York and...
